difficulty_guidelines.1: Config/doc change, single field addition, no schema changes
difficulty_guidelines.2: Single function or endpoint, no schema change, < 50 LOC
difficulty_guidelines.3: New feature: schema change + API + unit tests (typical PD-xx, DB-xx)
difficulty_guidelines.4: Multi-module feature, complex logic, cross-module integration dependencies
difficulty_guidelines.5: Cross-cutting changes, breaking changes, novel algorithms, new workflow type

notes: Estimates are indexed by (difficulty - 1), so difficulty=3 → index 2
Each rework iteration adds rework_surcharge_pct% to the affected step's base estimate
ISSUE-FIXER steps in WF-03 use backend-dev estimates
For multi-requirement runs, sum individual estimates (no compression discount yet — calibrate after 5+ retrospectives)
